Rubric criteria:

(2) Conformance: the spec's content is real. It declares a minimal Node CLI with source surface generated/hello-world.mjs, exact stdout "Hello, world!\n", exit 0 and no install. It lists the design, test and plan assets and says it is not a record of execution.

It matches the spec but does not cite it by path; I don't consider that material.

(5) Test design: it specifies component and UAT tests that both spawn the real entry with process.execPath and spawnSync from the project root, and assert status 0 and exact stdout. It requires at least 2 passes and 0 failures.
